Bunzl plc
is a global distribution and outsourcing company that supplies non-food consumables, food packaging, cleaning and hygiene products, and safety items through a mix of proprietary exclusive brands and partnerships with major international manufacturers.
Exclusive and Proprietary Brands
Bunzl operates various regional sub-brands and exclusive product lines tailored to specific market sectors like catering, cleaning, and retail:
Cascades PRO Sub-brands:
Includes
Cascades PRO Tandem
Cascades PRO Signature
Cascades PRO Perform
Cascades PRO Select
, and
Cascades PRO Tuff-Job
for recycled paper and hygiene wiping solutions.
Catering & Hospitality Exclusive Ranges:
Proprietary lines of food packaging, disposables, and tableware managed via local distribution arms like
Bunzl Catering Supplies
Techline Products:
Specialized range selected and optimized globally across collective Bunzl networks.
Major Manufacturer Partners & Vendors
Bunzl sources goods from a broad network of prominent global manufacturing brands, varying by division and geography:
Cleaning & Hygiene:
Clorox Pro, Bruske Products, and regional janitorial manufacturers.
Food Processing & Packaging:
Cambro, Carlisle, Bulman Products, and C-P Flexible Packaging.
Sustainable/Compostable Goods:
Certified suppliers vetted through cooperative groups like the Composter Manufacturing Alliance (CMA).
